tested_claim: The approved standardized scenario cannot achieve complete defense from t=0 because no smoke can exist before 5.5 s.

checks.name: availability_range
checks.perturbation: min_i(a_i) over the approved 0 to 3 s range
checks.limitation: The condition is necessary, not sufficient, outside the approved range.

checks.name: position_range
checks.perturbation: each x/y initial coordinate plus or minus 200 m
checks.limitation: Routes are not evaluated after the earlier hard-constraint failure.

checks.name: heading_range
checks.perturbation: each initial heading plus or minus 45 degrees
checks.limitation: Turn objectives are not evaluated without a feasible normal-defense candidate.

checks.name: safety_distance_range
checks.limitation: No formal d_safe feasibility threshold exists because the feasible set is already empty.

checks.name: missile_bearing_range
checks.metric: event-delay certificate after lock at t=0
checks.limitation: This relies on the human-approved premise that the full defense window begins at completed lock.

claim_limit: Only the approved t=0 and a_i>=0 scenario family is certified infeasible. Allowing pre-tasking at or before -5.5 s removes this particular obstruction but does not prove geometric feasibility.
